source_rule: Canonical app-owned visual profile. Native contrast bridge must prefer this file for colors/readability and use local saved settings only as fallback. Shadow depth is a separate visual-depth setting and may be locally adjusted by the Shadow Depth slider.
fallback_rule: If this file cannot be fetched or parsed, use localStorage keys pmp_single_colors_v6 / pmp_single_colors_v5 and pmp_readability_layer_v6 as fallback. Shadow depth uses localStorage key pmp_shadow_depth_v1 when present, otherwise this profile's shadow_depth.
